mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level, indicative of accommodative monetary policy, compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS level shows no significant correlation with 20-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 2-year rolling window, or returns in low-rate periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals weakening labor market conditions, increasing recession risk and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE above 5.0% fails to predict negative returns (20-day returns not significantly negative, t-test p > 0.05) in more than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signal tightening monetary policy and rising inflation, increasing equity risk premiums and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2pp in 1 month AND CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL fails to predict negative returns (20-day returns not significantly negative, t-test p > 0.05) in more than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS above 4.5% and rising for three consecutive months), increased risk aversion and reduced liquidity cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The monetary tightening cycle regime fails to predict negative returns (20-day returns not significantly negative, t-test p > 0.05) in more than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO level shows no significant correlation with 60-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 2-year rolling window, or returns in high-INDPRO periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) level above 2000 units signals strong residential construction activity, indicating a healthy economy and supporting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST above 2000 fails to predict positive returns (20-day returns not significantly positive, t-test p > 0.05) in more than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) above their 1-year moving averages signal robust demand for housing and related sectors, boosting economic growth and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and RSAFS above their 1-year moving averages fails to predict positive returns (20-day returns not significantly positive, t-test p > 0.05) in more than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) level above 2000 units signals immediate market reaction to strong residential demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST above 2000 fails to predict positive returns (5-day returns not significantly positive, t-test p > 0.05) in more than 40% of triggered instances.
